div.div: Solid lines are requests: every hop between Envoys is mutual TLS with a short-lived certificate per service account (SPIFFE identity), while the app speaks plain HTTP. Dashed teal lines are xDS configuration and certificates from istiod. If istiod is down, proxies keep their last configuration, but no new pod can start in an injected namespace.

text.tspan: Solid lines are requests: every hop between Envoys is mutual TLS with a short-lived certificate per service account (SPIFFE identity), while the app speaks plain HTTP.
